title: Kenya VAT Registration Threshold History
description: The mandatory VAT registration threshold under Kenyan law since the VAT Act 2013 commenced, including the reported-but-not-yet-operative KES 8M change. Essential context for the most-asked VAT question in Kenya: KES 5M or 8M?
attribution: SmartVAT Kenya (smartvatkenya.co.ke), from VAT Act 2013 (Cap. 476) s.14, KRA official guidance, and Finance Act 2025 commentary. Status verified 2026-09-27.

records.basis: VAT Act 2013 (Cap. 476), s.14 — mandatory registration where taxable turnover meets or exceeds KES 5,000,000 in any twelve consecutive months
records.notes: Measured on a rolling twelve-month window, not calendar year. KRA official guidance continues to apply this figure as of 2026-09-27.

records.basis: Reported via Finance Act 2025 commentary and subsequent tax-advisory publications
records.notes: An increase to KES 8,000,000 has been widely reported; KRA's operative systems and guidance continued applying KES 5,000,000 at verification date. SmartVAT tracks this on the threshold explainer and updates the status the moment KRA confirms.

caveats: Voluntary registration remains available below the mandatory threshold.
Non-resident suppliers of digital marketplace supplies register regardless of turnover under the 2023 Digital Marketplace Regulations.
